mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_comment (post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, reply_user_id, content, like_count, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{replyUserId}, #{content}, 0, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, reply_user_id, content, like_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM forum_comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 1

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.reply_user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, ru.username AS reply_username, ru.nickname AS reply_nickname FROM forum_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = c.reply_user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN c.comment_id ELSE c.parent_comment_id END ASC, c.parent_comment_id ASC, c.create_time ASC
SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, reply_user_id, content, like_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM forum_comment ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_comment SET status = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE forum_comment SET status = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_comment SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 1
UPDATE forum_comment SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_comment WHERE status = 1
